risks.name: MultusCniVersionThirdPartyCniBreak
risks.message: Clusters using third-party CNI plugins such as Cilium may completely fail after upgrading to this version due to a multus cniVersion incompatibility. Only host-network pods can be created. Clusters using OVN-Kubernetes are not affected. Update to 4.22.6 or later instead.

risks.name: KubeApiserverAnnotationUpdateFailure
risks.message: Hosted/HyperShift clusters upgrade would stuck due to failing attempts to update the immutable service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type annotation on the kube-apiserver Service.

risks.name: PreRelease
risks.message: This is a pre-release version, and you should update to a release version instead. If it is a minor update, it is suggested to upgrade to the latest patch version first.

risks.name: PortworxKernelModuleBuildFailure
risks.message:
Clusters running Portworx may have storage unavailable after upgrading to 4.22.9.
The RHCOS kernel version shipped with 4.22.9 (5.14.0-687.35.1.el9_8) is not
available in RHEL package repositories, preventing Portworx from building its
kernel module on upgraded nodes.

promql.promql:
group by (_id, name) (csv_succeeded{_id="",name=~"portworx-operator[.]v.*"})
or on (_id)
0 * label_replace(group by (_id) (csv_succeeded{_id=""}), "name", "portworx-operator not installed", "", "")

risks.name: S390xContainerDataFailure
risks.message: On s390x nodes, malformed container data prevents pod autoscaling, eviction, and metrics collection, affecting monitoring dashboards.

promql.promql:
topk(1,
  group by (label_kubernetes_io_arch) (kube_node_labels{_id="",label_kubernetes_io_arch="s390x"})
  or
  0 * group by (label_kubernetes_io_arch) (kube_node_labels{_id=""})
)

risks.name: VSphereConfigCloudControllerCrash
risks.message: On vSphere clusters whose Infrastructure spec.platformSpec.vsphere exists but has empty vcenters and failureDomains fields, updating causes cloud-controller-manager to crash, stopping node lifecycle management.
